name: review-bridge
description: Coordinate a two-round local code review between Codex and Claude Desktop.

interface.shortDescription: Hand code snapshots to Claude for local review
interface.longDescription: Create immutable review snapshots, receive structured Claude findings, respond with fixes or evidence, and stop after two rounds when human arbitration is required.
defaultPrompt: Prepare the current changes for a Claude Desktop review.
Check whether Claude has returned findings for this review.
